source_review.BetweenCoreOrthogroupsWorkflow: run/main.py:168-356 writes assigned partition and unassigned FASTAs, infers guide, then searches/clusters unassigned proteins within clades and appends families. Interrupted run has only its initial cluster file and lacks its native species-tree products.
source_review.from_trees: run/main.py qStartFromTrees takes orthologue inference path; it does not call BetweenCoreOrthogroupsWorkflow.
source_review.singleton_handling: accelerate.write_unassigned_fasta excludes all multi-member retained families, so all 60423 retained singleton proteins appear in discovery inputs. Any combined family partition must replace their old singleton membership when reassigned; blindly appending discovery groups would duplicate membership.
source_review.native_clade_behavior: Executed installed get_new_species_clades as-is on both conditional guides; actual coverage reported. No source patch or biological search performed.

remaining_requirements: Complete clade-specific discovery and gene trees before asserting complete orthology
Resolve singleton replacement and enforce unique combined protein membership
Evaluate guide-dependent discovery and cross-clade missed homology
Reconcile expanded validated family partition; retained-family-only reconciliation must be labeled conditional/incomplete
interpretation: Candidate pair arithmetic sizes the possible search space, not DIAMOND executed alignments, actual runtime, homology or inferred orthology. Scope correction prevents treating a --from-trees restart of the retained partition as full discovery completion.
